info.title: Acme Credit — lending core API
info.description: Secured credit card: accounts, collateral deposits, repayments, payouts, card authorizations (signed by the card network) and the admin back office. Amounts are strings of integer cents. Every error is the `ErrorEnvelope`; clients branch on `code`.

ErrorEnvelope.description: One envelope for every error. Codes: common.validation_failed, common.not_found, common.unauthenticated, common.forbidden, common.rate_limited, common.conflict, common.internal, common.payload_too_large, auth.invalid_credentials, auth.email_taken, auth.session_expired, idempotency.key_required, idempotency.key_reused, idempotency.in_progress, operation.in_progress, signature.invalid, account.already_open, account.not_active, account.not_frozen, account.closed, account.pending_holds, deposit.amount_out_of_range, repayment.exceeds_debt, repayment.no_debt, payment.not_confirmed, payment.provider_unavailable, authorization.not_capturable, authorization.not_reversible, authorization.capture_exceeds_hold, authorization.hold_released, account.frozen_by_admin, payment.deposit_cap_exceeded.
